summary: Frontend-only verification of the bonus prize redemption bug fix on /bonus. window.confirm has been successfully replaced by an in-app confirmation modal. End-to-end flow (modal open -> cancel, modal open -> confirm -> success toast + confetti + balance decrease) works correctly in both grid and list views.
critical_code_review_comments: BonusPage.js is 724 lines — consider splitting into PrizeGrid/PrizeList/RedeemConfirmModal subcomponents for maintainability.
Toast fallback message in doRedeemPrize (line 122) correctly handles the backend's missing 'message' field — confirmed acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on /bonus page (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL https://order-merge-fulfill.preview.emergentagent.com). Client starts with ~364,900 points. Test steps: 1) Login as user@demo.com/demo123, 2) navigate /bonus, 3) click data-testid='bonus-redeem-btn' for an affordable prize -> data-testid='redeem-confirm-modal' opens, 4) data-testid='redeem-cancel-btn' closes modal (note AnimatePresence exit ~500-1000ms, wait >=1000ms before asserting), 5) data-testid='redeem-confirm-btn' triggers POST /api/bonus/redeem-prize, shows green '🎉 Приз оформлен!' toast, data-testid='bonus-confetti' overlay appears for ~2.8s, and AnimatedNumber points balance decreases by prize cost. Both grid and list views open the same modal. Test results captured: 364,900 -> 363,900 after redeeming a 1000-point 'iphone' prize.
rca of the issue: Original bug: window.confirm() is suppressed in sandboxed/preview iframes so the Получить button appeared to do nothing. Fix verified: handleRedeemPrize now sets confirmPrize state which renders an in-app modal (lines 578-627 of /app/frontend/src/pages/BonusPage.js); doRedeemPrize performs the axios POST. Full flow confirmed working via Playwright.
